# mtncloud_image (Data Source)

Looks up one OS image you can provision, by its name or its code. To list them, use `mtncloud_images`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By the name shown in the console (case ignored), or by code.
data "mtncloud_image" "ubuntu" {
  name = "MTN Ubuntu Server 24.04.3LTS"
}

output "ubuntu_code" {
  value = data.mtncloud_image.ubuntu.code
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Image name, for example `MTN Ubuntu Server 24.04.3LTS` (case ignored), or its code, for example `MTN-U24.04LTS`.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) Image code, for example `MTN-U24.04LTS`.
- `full_name` (String) Display name, for example `MTN Ubuntu Server 24.04.3LTS`.
- `id` (Number) Image (instance type) ID.
- `layout_id` (Number) Layout ID used to provision the image.
